title: PowerPoint on the web: Copilot edits presentations through chat for Copilot Chat users (Worldwide)
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says the two PowerPoint web roadmap entries have no difference. One explicitly covers licensed users and brand-kit capabilities, while the other covers users without the Copilot licence; the documented licensing disagreement should remain, but these entries must not be described as duplicates.
